hypothesis: PRE-REGISTERED BASELINE (economics, not an edge test). D1 model (agents/daily/w1-prop/prop_model.py) re-implemented in agents/daily/w3-volrisk/stress_model.py; with no stress it reproduces D1 bit for bit (unit test). Firms: FTMO Swing 2-Step 100K, Blue Guardian 2-Step 100K, CFT 2-Phase 100K with D1's firms.py parameters. Each (firm, S) job simulates D1's full sigma grid {1..40}%/yr once (n=3000 paths, eval seed 11, funded seed 12; common random numbers across S and caps) and reads each vol cap c in {12,15,20,30,40(=no cap)}% as the best (sigma_e, sigma_f) pair with both <= c. Metric: pre-tax net $ per slot-year (renewal reward, as D1 and the synthesis table). S in {0,0.25,...,3.5}. Required Sharpe for $20k per slot-year = linear interpolation on that S grid, per firm and cap.
STRESS: fat tails. Every shock Student-t with 3 degrees of freedom scaled to unit variance (D1: t5). All else F2-01, S in {0,1,1.5,2}.

STRESS: gaps. Each trading day 25% of its variance arrives as one jump at the open before any equity check (overnight gap); every 5th trading day (Monday) the opening jump carries one extra day of variance (weekend gap); all variances scaled by 5/6 so annual vol stays sigma. Applied to all three firms (conservative for CFT, whose crypto trades on weekends). The bot has a kill switch: at 80% of the daily loss limit it closes everything and stays flat until the next day, so only a jump can carry it through the limit. Shocks t5. S in {0,1,1.5,2}.
CONTROL for F2-03: kill switch at 80% of the daily loss limit, no gaps. Separates what the kill switch saves from what gaps cost.

STRESS: volatility clustering. Daily variance multiplier h' = 0.02 + 0.10 z^2 + 0.88 h (GARCH(1,1)-like, persistence 0.98, E[h]=1), z = the day's book move in unconditional daily s.d., h capped at 16 (vol x4). Drift per day unchanged. t5. S in {0,1,1.5,2}.

STRESS: hard daily loss on equity including floating P&L, strictest convention. Reference = the HIGHER of start-of-day equity and start-of-day closed balance; closed balance lags equity, realising 10% of open P&L per day (daily-rebalanced book), and is set to equity when the bot flattens or takes a payout; equity checked against reference minus limit 24 times a day (D1: 4). Applied to all three firms. t5. S in {0,1,1.5,2}.

FIRM-EXACT rules from the firms' own pages (clauses-*.md, read 2026-10-12, before any F2 run), no market stress: FTMO 5% daily loss from the closed balance at 00:00 CE(S)T checked on equity (floating P&L counts), fee 510 refunded with the first reward; Blue Guardian funded daily loss 4% from the higher of balance or equity (D1 had a 2% hard proxy) plus the Guardian Shield = total open P&L <= -2% of start closes all trades, first trigger cuts the split to 50% (x0.97 processing fee) for the account's life, second breaches; refund 347 after the 4th payout; CFT fee $660 never refunded, 5% daily loss from the start-of-day balance, $10k profit cap per day per user = $3,333 per account in a 3-account fleet (excess cut). Where the reference is balance, closed balance lags equity at 10%/day as F2-06. S in {0,1,1.5,2}.

Blue Guardian only: F2-07 with a book that closes and reopens every position each day (all open P&L realised daily), the best case for the Guardian Shield. Trading cost of the daily round trip NOT modelled (optimistic).

DECIDES. Combined: t3 + gaps and kill switch (F2-03) + clustering (F2-05) + 24 checks a day, balance lag 10%/day (F2-06) + firm-exact rules (F2-07; the daily-loss reference is the firm's own, not the F2-06 envelope). S in {0,0.25,...,3.5}; required Sharpe for $20k per slot-year by linear interpolation per firm and cap. Max safe vol per firm = the largest cap c in {12,15,20,30}% such that (a) no clause is breached at c and the clause reader does not rate c high-risk, and (b) under F2-09 at S=1.0 net $/slot-yr at c exceeds that at the next lower cap by more than $250 (about 2 Monte Carlo s.e.); breach-before-first-payout share reported alongside.

REAL FEE AND REFUND TIMING: the calendar-order chain (D1 slot_years, 2000 slots x 3 years) under F2-07 rules: every evaluation fee paid when bought, the refund paid on the date of the refund payout (FTMO 1st, Blue Guardian 4th, CFT never). Reports year-1 mean, p10 and P(loss) and years-2-3 mean, p10, p50 per slot, at S in {0,1,1.5,2} and caps 12, 20, 40% (sigma pair from F2-07).

LOTTERY CHECK: as F2-10 under F2-09 (all stresses). The Sharpe-0 'lottery' survives only if, under F2-09, S=0 at the uncapped optimum gives positive net $/slot-yr in renewal reward AND a positive years-2-3 median per slot in the calendar chain.
